verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a REST API with Basic Auth, a Postman collection, webhooks and an llms.txt file, with no mention of an official MCP server. llms.txt and the REST API are adjacent building blocks, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
